title: Material-specific dry-tail fallback reconciliation
finding_before_repair: F-AHL10D preregistered analytical fallback outside the material-specific represented domain, but the current research provider only falls back outside the global [-1e6,-1] cm domain. For O05 this would clamp/extrapolate the final table interval below the qualified raw-C=1e-13 bound at approximately -2.642775e5 cm instead of using the authoritative analytical provider.
test_cases: O05 at h=-2e5 cm must use lookup domain
O05 at h=-5e5 cm must use analytical fallback
values returned in analytical-fallback tail must match authoritative theta,C,K exactly within floating-point tolerance
